meta.name: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
meta.description: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

videos.title: Ultimate Robot Battle vs Dude Perfect
videos.overview: It's five against one when Dude Perfect challenges Mark to an epic robot showdown that's full of surprises. The only rule is... there are no rules.

videos.title: Beating 5 Scam Arcade Games
videos.overview: Mark builds robots to beat the five most common arcade games, shares secret strategies to win tons of tickets and exposes some of the biggest scams.

videos.title: World's Largest Jello Pool
videos.overview: After spending six months studying Jell-O, Mark sets out to fill an entire pool with it so he can see what it would be like to do a Jell-O belly flop.

videos.title: Octopus vs Underwater Maze
videos.overview: Mark challenges his pet octopus Sashimi to a nine-part underwater obstacle course that tests her amazing intelligence and incredible dexterity.

videos.title: Egg Drop From Space
videos.overview: "Mark starts out with a plan to drop an egg from the world's tallest building but shifts gears to attempt the world's largest egg drop... from space.

videos.title: Unbeatable Rock Paper Scissors Robot
videos.overview: Learn the science behind some of the coolest CrunchLabs creations, from a room-temperature ice rink to a rock, paper, scissors robot that can't lose.

videos.title: Acid vs. Lava Destruction Test
videos.overview: In a scientific face-off, Mark goes head-to-head with NileRed and Kevin the Backyard Scientist to find out which is more destructive: acid or lava.

videos.title: Backyard Squirrel Obstacle Course
videos.overview: To stop the sneaky squirrels from raiding his bird feeder, Mark builds a challenging eight-part obstacle course in his backyard to try and slow them down.

videos.title: World's Largest Devil's Toothpaste
videos.overview: Mark throws an epic birthday party for a deserving teen, complete with record-breaking devil's toothpaste experiment - the first of its kind.

videos.title: Beating Carnival Scams With Science
videos.overview: Step right up and learn which carnival games are actually winnable and which ones aren't, courtesy of Mark... and a friend from the New York Mets.

videos.title: My Domino Robot Broke A World Record
videos.overview: Mark's robot Dom is really good at setting up dominos. But can he fill a warehouse with a mural made up od more than 100,000 of them in just 24 hours?

videos.title: Engineers vs. Extreme Hide & Seek
videos.overview: Mark has 30 minutes to find all nine product designers hidden inside the CrunchLabs warehouse - and they're allowed to fight back with blasters!

videos.title: My Experience Building The Mars Rover
videos.overview: In honor of the historic Perseverance Mars rover landing, Mark talks to some of his old friends at NASA and suits up to see the actual rover up close.

videos.title: Lava vs Laser Destruction Test
videos.overview: What's the most destructive substance on Earth? Lava's the reigning champ - but how do lasers stack up? Mark and his friends are about to find out.

videos.title: Backyard Squirrel 2.0 - Bank Heist
videos.overview: Mark ups his backyard obstacle course game to keep four thieving squirrels away from a bank vault full of birdseed and a lifetime supply of walnuts.

videos.title: Building a Liquid Sand Hot Tub
videos.overview: With the right amount of forced air, a hot tub filled with sand can look like a bubbling pot of soup. But how? Mark breaks down the science behind it.

videos.title: This Ball Is Impossible to Hit
videos.overview: Mark uses the magic of engineering to level the playing field in a stacked competition against the world's greatest wiffle ball players.

videos.title: Vortex Cannon vs Drone
videos.overview: Mark explores the possibilities of anti-drone defense technologies with a crew of backyard YouTube engineers... and the world's largest vortex cannon.

videos.title: Glitter Bomb 1.0 vs Porch Pirates
videos.overview: Stolen packages? Not so fast. Mark builds the original "Glitter Bomb" trap to combat porch pirates-and really make them regret their life choices.

videos.title: Engineers vs Food Robots
videos.overview: From cereal and milk to spaghetti and meatballs: Things get messy when the CrunchLabs team cooks up new ways to make Mark's mealtimes more efficient.

videos.title: Mark Rober vs Ninja Kidz
videos.overview: It's not just the Ninja Kidz - it's the whole Ninja Fam! And Mark's challenging them all to a silly series of "Minute to Win It" style challenges.

videos.title: Engineers vs Custom Go Kart Racing
videos.overview: CrunchLabs product designers get 24 hours to build and race their own custom go-karts incorporating engineering know-how-and the element of surprise.

videos.title: Moving Train Jump Test
videos.overview: To answer an assortment of science puzzles, Mark takes his experiments to the next level — on top of a moving train and up high in a hot air balloon!

videos.title: Lasers vs. Lightning Destruction Test
videos.overview: Now it's lasers vs. lightning in a showdown to find out which one is more destructive. With a series of tests, the CrunchLabs crew declares a champ.

videos.title: Glitter Bomb 2.0 vs. Porch Pirates
videos.overview: Actor Macaulay Culkin joins Mark as he unleashes upgraded bait packages full of glitter — and stinky fart spray — to lure potential thieves.

videos.title: How to Escape a Police Sniffing Dog
videos.overview: Mark's running for his life while being hunted down by an expert tracking dog. Can he engineer some distractions to throw the dog off her game?

videos.title: Backyard Squirrel Olympics 3.0
videos.overview: Let the games begin! From a high jump to a spinning balance beam, Mark's set up a series of backyard battles for squirrels competing for the Walnut Cup.

videos.title: I Built My Own Space Satellite
videos.overview: One small step in space, one giant leap for taking a selfie. Mark preps a satellite to snap pics of the Earth photobombing the selfies sent by his fans.

videos.title: I Spent $5M So You Can Go to Space
videos.overview: Get ready for liftoff! After three years of work and spending millions of dollars, can Mark ensure his selfie-taking satellite has a successful launch?
